text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: I witnessed it, Trainer! The exact moment an Umamusume's instinct blossomed under your guidance!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I only intended to do a quick inspection,
but this was an unexpected haul! Dahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! That gives me an idea!
Let me share what I learned on that deserted island.
I'd be thrilled if it helps you reach new heights!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Together, let us advance the future of Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
This could definitely be put to use for deserted island facilities...!
My thanks, Trainer!
